regions.details: Universities that do not use Uni-Assist (e.g. RWTH Aachen, TU Munich for certain faculties, University of Stuttgart) charge €0 application fees.
Most Italian public universities (Politecnico di Torino, University of Bologna, Sapienza) charge €0 to €30 minimal fees for international pre-enrollment.
100% Free Application with zero fees. No submission charges whatsoever.
Offers automatic application fee waivers to applicants from developing countries.

options.name: English as Medium of Instruction (MOI) Certificate
options.description: If your bachelor's degree was conducted in English, request an official 'Medium of Instruction Certificate' from your registrar. Many European, Asian, and UK universities accept this in lieu of IELTS/TOEFL.

options.name: Duolingo English Test (DET)
options.description: Accepted by over 4,500 institutions worldwide. Cost is ~$59 USD (vs $220+ for IELTS/TOEFL). Results delivered in 48 hours.

options.name: Fulbright & DAAD Test Vouchers
options.description: Shortlisted candidates for Fulbright receive fully sponsored TOEFL and GRE test vouchers paid for by the US Department of State.
